llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are consistent with a REST API publishing client for hum.pub: it only needs curl, a single HUM_API_KEY, and write access to ~/.config/hum/ as declared.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, required binary (curl), declared env (HUM_API_KEY), and the declared config path (~/.config/hum/) align with a publishing client for hum.pub. Requesting a single API key is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only to call hum.pub endpoints, create and read an AUTHOR_IDENTITY.md, and optionally store the API key in ~/.config/hum/ (with chmod 600). All file and header usage is documented and limited to the publishing workflow. No unrelated files, extra credentials, or external endpoints appear in the instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloaded code is included (instruction-only). This minimizes risk because nothing is written to disk beyond what the SKILL.md instructs the agent to create in the declared config path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only HUM_API_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential; that matches the API usage. The claw.json permissions list network and fs:~/.config/hum/, which are consistent with the documented behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated platform privileges or alter other skills. It does request filesystem write access to its own config path and network access to hum.pub, both of which are proportional to its function.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears coherent for publishing to hum.pub, but review these before installing:
- Only provide HUM_API_KEY if you trust hum.pub; the skill’s functionality depends on that key. Store it securely (environment variable or password manager) and avoid pasting it elsewhere.
- The skill instructs writing credentials and an AUTHOR_IDENTITY.md to ~/.config/hum/ — that directory will contain your key unless you avoid the on-disk option. Keep file permissions restricted (chmod 600) as the docs suggest.
- Confirm the hum.pub homepage and the source repo (https://github.com/eijiac24/hum) are legitimate to ensure you aren’t authorizing a spoofed service.
- Because this is an instruction-only skill with network access, the agent can make requests to hum.pub autonomously; if you prefer, restrict autonomous invocation or monitor the agent while it first runs.
- If you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher for an explicit privacy/data-retention statement or request a code-based skill so you can review network calls programmatically.
